population.scope: Exactly all ordered a,b in {0,1,2,3}, total in {0,1,2,3,4,5,6}, color in {A,B}; 224 equally weighted structured records
population.reference: Acceptable iff BigInt(a) + BigInt(b) equals BigInt(total). Color has no effect on acceptability. This is a mathematical specification of supplied records, not prose interpretation or business truth.
population.weighting: Uniform over the 224 records for decision utility; uniform within each label for error rates
population.sampling: Complete enumeration; no random sampling and no independent-person or independent-draw assumption
population.evidenceUse: Reusable constructed control population. Evaluators and cases are designed together; repeated runs are expected. No held-out or confirmatory sampling claim. Definition is loaded and bound before each execution; the local registration digest is not a trusted preregistration timestamp.

outage.purpose: Deliberately configured fault injection; retain absent, explicitly unavailable, and thrown outcomes without relabeling them.

decisions.perspective: Operator accepting or rejecting one uniformly drawn record from this exact finite population
decisions.horizon: One decision after at most one assessment
decisions.conversion: One actually executed assessment dispatch is assigned 0.1 utility points by the example operator. This is a declared exchange rate, not measured financial value, latency, token spend, or business loss.

uncertainty.interpretation: Operator-supplied uncertainty rectangle, not a confidence interval or posterior. Selection that changes over the rectangle remains unresolved.

unitDefinitions.assessment_steps: One actual assertion dispatch, including an explicit unavailable return or thrown attempt
unitDefinitions.rounds: Core loop attempted rounds, reported independently of the three budget dimensions

claimsExcluded: Human comprehension, reader preference, semantic extraction or prose fidelity
Calibration for any input outside the exact finite population
Business causal effects, learned utilities, monetary or token spending
Global policy optimality beyond the enumerated one-assessment model
Automatic identification from observation, or execution permission from remedy metadata
